step1_analysis.circuit_type: Shunt Regulator Error Amplifier and Shunt Transistor
step1_analysis.description: This circuit regulates the internal supply voltage extracted from an RF field. It uses a differential amplifier to compare a feedback voltage to a reference, driving a PMOS shunt transistor to clamp the supply by shunting excess current to an isolated ground.

paper_reference.title: Secure Contactless Smartcard ASIC with DPA Protection

open_loop_gain.description: Low-frequency voltage gain of the error amplifier from the feedback input to the shunt gate control node.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm2 * (ro2 || ro4). With L=0.5u, gm ~ 340uS, Rout ~ 232kOhm, Gain ~ 79 V/V = 38 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using SKY130 parameters. Lower than the paper's 66 dB due to the use of simple current mirrors and short channel length (L=0.5u) in the extracted netlist, whereas the paper likely used cascoding.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the error amplifier and quiescent shunt current.

sky130_expected.calculation: I_total = I_tail + I_shunt + I_mirror = 43uA + 21.5uA + 21.5uA = 86uA. Power = 86uA * 1.8V = 155 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on a tail current set by BIAS=0.6V. The paper's 2.5 mW likely includes the full chip or a much larger nominal shunt current required for RF regulation.

shunt_impedance.description: Small-signal resistance of the shunt transistor (1/gm).

sky130_expected.reasoning: The extracted netlist uses a parameterized W=5u for the shunt transistor, resulting in high impedance. A real RF shunt design would use W > 1000u to achieve the < 3 ohms reported in the paper.

unity_gain_frequency.description: Frequency at which the error amplifier open-loop gain drops to 0 dB.

sky130_expected.calculation: UGF = gm2 / (2 * pi * C_load). Assuming parasitic C_load ~ 10fF, UGF ~ 5 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Highly dependent on the load capacitance at N1. Without an explicit load capacitor in the netlist, parasitic capacitance dominates, leading to a very high UGF compared to the paper.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure the open-loop gain, unity gain frequency, phase margin, DC trip point, and transient response of the shunt regulator error amplifier.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Shunt Regulator Error Amplifier
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xmshunt=5u L_xmshunt=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u

XM4 N1 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XMSHUNT N4 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmshunt} w={W_xmshunt}
XM2 N1 N3 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N0 VREF N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM5 N0 N0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM1 N2 BIAS N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}

* Connect isolated ground N4 to main GND for testing
V_N4 N4 0 0

* DC Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVREF VREF 0 0.9
VBIAS BIAS 0 0.6

* Input Signal at Feedback Node (N3)
VN3 N3 0 dc 0.9 ac 1 pulse(0.8 1.0 1n 1n 1n 5u 10u)

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * AC Analysis for Open-Loop Gain and Phase
  ac dec 100 1 10G
  let gain_db = vdb(N1)
  let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(N1))
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
  meas ac ugf when gain_db=0 fall=1
  meas ac phase_at_ugf find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1

  * DC Sweep for Transfer Characteristic
  dc VN3 0 1.8 0.01
  meas dc trip_point when v(N1)=0.9 fall=1

  * Transient Analysis for Step Response
  tran 10n 10u
  meas tran trise trig v(N1) val=0.5 rise=1 targ v(N1) val=1.3 rise=1
  meas tran tfall trig v(N1) val=1.3 fall=1 targ v(N1) val=0.5 fall=1

  quit
.endc
